name: @yosefsabag/mediapipe-pose
description: On-device MediaPipe pose landmarks for Expo, with a camera view, named joints, and a skeleton.

scripts.build: rm -rf build plugin/build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p plugin/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:swift: node -e "if(process.platform!=='darwin'){console.log('Swift frame-timing tests skipped: they run only on macOS.');process.exit(0)}const{mkdirSync}=require('fs'),{spawnSync}=require('child_process');mkdirSync('node_modules/.cache',{recursive:true});const o='node_modules/.cache/frame-timing-tests';const c=spawnSync('xcrun',['swiftc','ios/PoseFrameTiming.swift','ios/PoseFrameTimingTests.swift','-o',o],{stdio:'inherit'});if(c.status!==0)process.exit(1);process.exit(spawnSync(o,{stdio:'inherit'}).status??1)"
scripts.lint: biome check . && eslint src plugin app.plugin.js vitest.config.ts --max-warnings 0
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

author: Yosef Hayim Sabag
